hero.subtitle: Each template is a fully-functional, Stripe-integrated AI SaaS you can deploy to Vercel in minutes. Charge your users, keep the revenue — Muapi handles the AI infrastructure.

step1.title: Deploy in Minutes
step1.description: Fork the open-source template, add your Muapi key, and push to Vercel. No backend setup needed.

step2.title: Collect Payments
step2.description: Stripe is pre-wired. Set your own pricing — one-time credits, subscriptions, or pay-per-use.

step3.title: Keep the Revenue
step3.description: Payments go straight to your Stripe account. You own the product, the brand, and the profits.
